title: Connect evidence reuse decisions to real verification execution
rawUserRequest: 查收，全部修复。Outcome 必须在对话框直接完整输出并带 🔴🟢🟡；发现问题尽量在当前 WI 解决，必要时才开边界清晰的新 WI；reference-impact 与 strict quality 在非必要情况下不应被触发；本次初始验收的 Incremental Verification & Evidence Reuse 仍部分通过，必须把既有 content/diff/environment reuse 决策接入实际 Verification Planner/执行路径，证明少跑且不绕过 required gates，并同步未来安装对象工程。用户授权全部必要的 scoped corrective changes、并行 WI（边界独立时）和需要的仓库写入；发布/tag 不属于本 WI。

sources.reason: The initial acceptance identifies the missing planner/execution bridge and WI-A/WI-B/WI-C reuse scenarios.
The current verification CLI builds a runtime plan but does not pass it to an execution adapter.
The predecessor runtime module contains the fail-closed plan and execution seam that must be connected to the CLI.
Existing checker and gate vocabulary must remain authoritative for execution.
Existing exact evidence-binding primitives define the reuse boundary.
Existing diff-bound classification must cause rerun when the diff binding changes.
Existing environment-bound classification must cause rerun on runtime/toolchain mismatch.
The installed adopter must receive the same runtime entry point and behavior.

reasons: The runtime changes verification execution decisions and evidence integrity, so strict governance is required.

preReviewWarnings: The archived predecessor is immutable and remains yellow; this successor must prove that ai_verify consumes the plan and records actual execution reduction.
Protected security, scope, governance, coverage, and source-bound gates must never be skipped.
Unknown, stale, malformed, missing, expired, or binding-mismatched evidence must execute again or fail closed.
Metrics must show actual planned, executed, stale-rerun, unknown-rerun, and reused counts; planner telemetry alone is not proof.
The installed adopter must receive the same runtime behavior through the catalog/template parity path.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: ai_verify creates an explicit execute-or-skip plan and a bounded execution adapter consumes that plan on the real verification path.
Only an allowlisted non-protected node with a validated passed, non-expired receipt and exact command/scope/governance/policy/environment/toolchain/output/stage/runner bindings may be skip_reused.
Missing, unknown, stale, malformed, expired, dependency-invalid, or binding-mismatched evidence executes again with an explicit reason code.
Security, scope, governance, coverage, and source-bound gates are protected and never skipped by reuse.

A regression test proves an unrelated documentation change reduces actual executed reusable nodes while protected execution remains unchanged; metrics report planned, executed, skipped, stale-rerun, unknown-rerun, and protected counts.
WI-A/WI-B/WI-C scenarios cover source change, unrelated documentation change, hosted stage separation, diff-bound rerun, environment mismatch rerun, and unknown evidence.
The Make entry point, runtime module, installer catalog/template, documentation, and installed-runtime parity tests expose identical behavior to future adopter projects.
Capability truth and paired pre-release documentation-alignment projections are regenerated so evidenceSource digests match current bytes.
The measured governance-complexity repayment is bounded to this runtime seam and does not raise unrelated ceilings.
guidelines: Keep planner decisions pure and keep subprocess execution in the bounded verification/execution seam.
Do not weaken or bypass required security, scope, governance, coverage, source-bound, or final-proof checks.
Use explicit machine-readable reason codes and metrics for every reuse or rerun decision.
Synchronize runtime code, installer catalog, template, docs, and parity tests without changing unrelated lifecycle behavior.

intent.problem: The predecessor added fail-closed evidence-reuse planning, but the current ai_verify path only prints runtimePlan and still executes the legacy registry path without consuming the plan. Therefore the repository cannot prove that eligible checks are actually skipped or that elapsed governance work is reduced.
constraints: Start from current origin/main and preserve the predecessor's immutable archive and yellow Outcome.
Reuse is an explicit allowlist and protected gates remain mandatory execution gates.
A reused node is satisfied only by a validated passed receipt with exact current bindings; local evidence cannot satisfy Hosted execution.
Keep the fix bounded to the runtime seam, tests, docs, and installed-adopter parity; do not redesign scheduler or lifecycle semantics.
intent.rationale: Wiring the existing plan into the actual execution adapter, with an end-to-end executed-count test, is the smallest root fix that can demonstrate time reduction without converting telemetry into a gate bypass.

declaredIntent.summary: Connect evidence reuse policy decisions to actual verification execution.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Catalog, template, runtime module, and parity tests expose the same planner/executor behavior.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run installer parity and adopter smoke tests.
